symptom: `show features` had no `mxcli syntax` topic; 8 of 115 topics carried a hand-written MinVersion that disagreed with sdk/versions (boundary event 10.6.0 vs 10.14.0, view entities 10.18.0 vs 10.21.0, notify 11.7.0 although the statement is 10.0), data-transformer had none; `list features for version 10.20.0` and `list features in workflows` were parse errors
cause: two version tables maintained by hand with no join; NUMBER_LITERAL lexes one dot, and the area slot took IDENTIFIER though the area names are lexer keywords
file: cmd/mxcli/syntax/registry.go (Features, Register refuses MinVersion), cmd/mxcli/syntax/versions.go, cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_versions_test.go (ledger), sdk/versions/registry.go (Lookup, Keys), mdl/grammar/domains/MDLCatalog.g4 (featureVersion, identifierOrKeyword)
insight: Remove the second table instead of syncing it: topics name registry features ('area/name') and versions are filled from the registry at lookup, and Register panics on a hand-written MinVersion, so drift cannot reappear. Close the reverse direction with a shrinking ledger test (every registry key referenced by some topic, or listed with a reason). A topic spanning several features lists each with its own version; use the FIRST feature as the topic's MinVersion, not the lowest — 'lowest' made data-transformer read 11.4 (the transform action) though its document is 11.9. When documenting a statement, run every documented form: two of the four `list features` forms did not parse.
